### Professional Summary

::: {.resume-summary}
Data Scientist and Statistician with experience delivering analytics solutions across retail, QSR, banking, academic research, and industry consulting. Skilled in translating raw data and complex business problems into client-facing metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights. Experienced in computer vision analytics, data integrity testing, predictive modeling, market analytics, experimental design, and statistical validation. Co-founder of Stat IQ, where I support clients in designing rigorous research methodologies and interpreting results for decision-making. Proficient in Python, R, SQL, and dashboarding tools, with a strong focus on analytical rigor, business relevance, and clear stakeholder communication.
:::

#### [AD-GEnKS Adaptive MCMC](https://github.com/ajhoneslacubtan/AD-GEnKS-AdaptiveMCMC)
*R, Bayesian modeling, adaptive MCMC, spatiotemporal forecasting*

- Implemented adaptive MCMC workflows for Bayesian dynamic spatiotemporal models.

- Applied Word2Vec for feature extraction using a pre-trained model from the Filipino Word Embeddings repository.
- Built a reproducible pipeline for preprocessing, model training, and evaluation.
